title: Interception of assignment data in transit
description: If the data flow is not encrypted, attackers could intercept the student's submission, exposing sensitive information such as the work file and student ID.
uncertainty_note: Node ID D.1.1 is assumed based on common LINDDUN Pro structure for data in transit disclosure.

title: Linkability via submission metadata
description: Metadata such as submission timestamps and course information could be used to link the student's activities across different submissions, enabling profiling or tracking.
uncertainty_note: Node ID L.1.1 is assumed; actual node may vary in LINDDUN Pro tree.

title: Data misuse beyond intended purpose
description: The Grades Portal may process the student's data for purposes other than grade management, such as analytics or sharing with third parties without explicit consent.
uncertainty_note: Node ID Dd.1.1 is assumed based on typical data misuse categorization.

title: Identifiability through data linkage
description: Combining the student's submission data with other datasets could re-identify the student, even if anonymized, leading to privacy breaches.
uncertainty_note: Node ID I.1.1 is assumed; actual node may differ in LINDDUN Pro tree.

title: Processing without legal basis
description: The portal may process student data without a valid legal basis under GDPR or similar regulations, leading to non-compliance.
uncertainty_note: Node ID Nc.1.1 is assumed; actual node may vary.

title: Disclosure of data in transit
description: Data transmitted between P1 and P2 may be intercepted if not encrypted, leading to unauthorized access to student information.
assumptions: Assumes no encryption is in place; actual implementation may vary.
uncertainty_note: Depends on transport security measures (e.g., TLS) not specified in flow description.

title: Insecure data storage
description: P2 may store received data without adequate security controls, risking unauthorized access to student records.
assumptions: Assumes P2 lacks robust access controls or encryption at rest.
uncertainty_note: Depends on P2's security practices, which are not detailed.

title: Linkability of student data
description: Sharing student ID and course information may allow linking to other datasets, increasing re-identification risk.
assumptions: Assumes data is combined with external sources.
uncertainty_note: Linkability risk depends on data availability in other systems.

title: Secondary use of data
description: P2 may use data for purposes beyond grading (e.g., analytics) without explicit consent.
assumptions: Assumes P2's data policies permit secondary use.
uncertainty_note: Depends on P2's data governance framework.

title: Lack of transparency
description: Students may not be informed that their data is shared with P2, violating informed consent principles.
assumptions: Assumes no user notification or consent mechanism exists.
uncertainty_note: Depends on P1's privacy communication practices.

title: Direct identification via student ID in transmitted data
description: The grading service includes the student ID in the data sent to the store, allowing direct identification of the student.
